name: iso15926
label: ISO 15926 (Oil & Gas)
description: Plant lifecycle data integration standard — dominant in oil & gas and process industries

table_notes.iso15926_class: Reference Data Library (RDL) type hierarchy from POSCCAESAR; each row is a class (type) in the ISO 15926-2 ontology, organized by superclass.
table_notes.iso15926_individual: Specific physical or functional objects (equipment items, pipelines, instruments) instantiating a class, with full lifecycle timestamps and flexible JSONB properties.
table_notes.iso15926_activity: Engineering or operational activities (construction, commissioning, maintenance) that occur at a location and involve one or more parties over a defined time window.
table_notes.iso15926_document: Engineering documents (P&IDs, datasheets, procedures) linked to the RDL class hierarchy, with revision tracking and status lifecycle management.

iso15926_class.name: id
iso15926_class.description: Internal surrogate key for this class (UUID, stable across imports)

iso15926_class.name: uri
iso15926_class.description: Globally unique IRI identifying this class in the POSCCAESAR RDL or vendor namespace

iso15926_class.name: name
iso15926_class.description: Human-readable label for this class as defined in the RDL

iso15926_class.name: description
iso15926_class.description: Normative definition of this class from the ISO 15926-2 data model

iso15926_class.name: superclass_id
iso15926_class.description: Parent class in the RDL type hierarchy (self-referencing FK to iso15926_class.id)

iso15926_class.name: namespace
iso15926_class.description: Ontology namespace (e.g. http://posccaesar.org/rdl/ or a project-specific prefix)

iso15926_individual.name: id
iso15926_individual.description: Internal surrogate key for this individual object (UUID)

iso15926_individual.name: uri
iso15926_individual.description: Globally unique IRI identifying this individual across plant data exchange

iso15926_individual.name: name
iso15926_individual.description: Tag number or functional name of the physical/functional object (e.g. 101-P-001)

iso15926_individual.name: class_id
iso15926_individual.description: References iso15926_class.id to type this object (e.g. Centrifugal Pump, Pipeline)

iso15926_individual.name: description
iso15926_individual.description: Free-text description of this specific equipment item or functional object

iso15926_individual.name: lifecycle_begin
iso15926_individual.description: Timestamp when this object entered existence (e.g. fabrication or first commissioning date)

iso15926_individual.name: lifecycle_end
iso15926_individual.description: Timestamp when this object ceased to exist (e.g. decommissioning date; NULL if still active)

iso15926_individual.name: properties
iso15926_individual.description: Flexible key-value bag of typed attributes ({"attribute_uri": value}); structure follows RDL property definitions

iso15926_activity.name: id
iso15926_activity.description: Internal surrogate key for this activity (UUID)

iso15926_activity.name: name
iso15926_activity.description: Descriptive name of the activity (e.g. Hydrostatic Test, Insulation Installation)

iso15926_activity.name: activity_type_id
iso15926_activity.description: References iso15926_class.id classifying the activity type from the RDL

iso15926_activity.name: begin_time
iso15926_activity.description: Scheduled or actual start time of the activity

iso15926_activity.name: end_time
iso15926_activity.description: Scheduled or actual completion time of the activity (NULL if ongoing)

iso15926_activity.name: location_id
iso15926_activity.description: References iso15926_individual.id for the physical location where activity takes place

iso15926_activity.name: involved_parties
iso15926_activity.description: Array of party objects ([{"role": "contractor", "party_uri": "..."}]) recording participants and their roles

iso15926_document.name: id
iso15926_document.description: Internal surrogate key for this document (UUID)

iso15926_document.name: document_number
iso15926_document.description: Project document number per the document management system (DMS) numbering convention

iso15926_document.name: title
iso15926_document.description: Full document title as it appears on the document header

iso15926_document.name: revision
iso15926_document.description: Revision identifier (e.g. A, B, 0, 1, IFR, IFC) per the project revision sequence

iso15926_document.name: document_type_id
iso15926_document.description: References iso15926_class.id classifying the document type (P&ID, datasheet, procedure)

iso15926_document.name: issue_date
iso15926_document.description: Date this revision was officially issued or approved

iso15926_document.name: status
iso15926_document.description: Document lifecycle status (e.g. IFR=Issued for Review, IFC=Issued for Construction, AFC=As-built)

iso15926_document.name: file_url
iso15926_document.description: URL or path to the document file in the DMS or object storage

iso15926_document.name: tags
iso15926_document.description: Array of tag/equipment references this document covers (["101-P-001", "101-V-002"])

short_description: Plant lifecycle data integration standard — dominant in oil & gas and process industries
long_description: ISO 15926 is the process industries data integration standard, covering the lifecycle of oil & gas plants, chemical plants, and other complex industrial facilities from design through decommissioning. The schema implements Part 2 (Data model) with classes (types in the POSCCAESAR RDL), individuals (specific equipment items), activities, and engineering documents.
when_to_use: Use for plant information management systems, digital twin platforms for process industries, or asset management systems in oil & gas, chemicals, or power generation. Mandated by major operators including Shell, BP, Equinor, and Saudi Aramco for vendor data deliverables. Required for ISO 15926-compliant handover packages on major capital projects.
